==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Energy]] -5
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Caged Shortbow]] [[dye]]d white.

*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
